docs.title: 30. Praktik Speaking
docs.text: Gunakan informasi diri sendiri untuk berlatih.

docs.title: Part 1 — Greeting
docs.text: A: Hello! How are you? B: I'm ____, thanks. And you?

docs.title: Part 2 — Age
docs.text: A: How old are you? B: I'm ____ years old.

docs.title: Part 3 — Phone Number
docs.text: A: What is your phone number? B: It is ____.

docs.title: Part 4 — Objects
docs.text:
Ambil beberapa benda di sekitar kamu dan praktikkan:

A: What is this? B: It is my ____.

Kemudian gunakan beberapa benda:

A: What are these? B: They are my ____.

docs.title: Part 5 — Quantity
docs.text: A: How many _ do you have? B: I have _ ____.

docs.title: 31. 🎯 Kesimpulan
docs.text:
Pada Lesson 2: How Are You?, kita mempelajari beberapa konsep dasar bahasa Inggris.

Hal utama yang perlu diingat:

  1. How are you? → menanyakan kabar.
  2. How's it going? dan What's up? → ungkapan informal.
  3. Numbers → angka 1–100.
  4. -teen digunakan pada angka 13–19.
  5. -ty digunakan pada angka puluhan.
  6. Angka seperti twenty-one menggunakan hyphen (-).
  7. What is your phone number? → menanyakan nomor telepon.
  8. How old are you? → menanyakan usia.
  9. Singular → satu benda.
  10. Plural → dua atau lebih.
  11. This / That → satu benda.
  12. These / Those → beberapa benda.
  13. How many? → menanyakan jumlah benda yang dapat dihitung.
  14. I have two pens. → contoh jawaban untuk menyatakan jumlah.

💡 Target latihan: Kamu sebaiknya mampu melakukan percakapan sederhana untuk menanyakan kabar, menyebutkan angka, nomor telepon, usia, benda di sekitar, serta jumlah benda yang dimiliki.

docs.title: Beginner English — Lesson 3: What Does She Look Like?
docs.text: Materi pembelajaran berdasarkan Beginner Levels – Lesson 3: What Does She Look Like? dari English For You.

docs.title: 🎯 Tujuan Pembelajaran
docs.text:
Setelah mempelajari materi ini, kamu diharapkan mampu:

  • Menggunakan kata sifat (adjectives) untuk mendeskripsikan seseorang atau benda.
  • Membuat kalimat positif dan negatif menggunakan to be.
  • Membuat pertanyaan Yes/No menggunakan to be.
  • Mendeskripsikan penampilan fisik seseorang.
  • Mendeskripsikan rambut dan mata seseorang.
  • Mendeskripsikan kepribadian seseorang.
  • Menggabungkan beberapa kata sifat menggunakan and dan but.
  • Membedakan pertanyaan tentang penampilan fisik dan kepribadian.

docs.title: 1.1 Posisi Kata Sifat (Adjectives)
docs.text:
Adjective adalah kata yang digunakan untuk memberikan informasi atau menjelaskan kata benda (noun).

Salah satu posisi adjective yang umum adalah sebelum noun.

docs.title: Pola
docs.text:
Adjective + Noun

Contoh:

  • nice teacher → guru yang baik
  • good student → siswa yang baik
  • smart student → siswa yang pintar
  • tall man → pria yang tinggi

Contoh kalimat:

She is a nice teacher.

He is a good student.

docs.title: 1.2 Adjective Tidak Berubah untuk Singular dan Plural
docs.text:
Dalam bahasa Inggris, adjective tidak berubah bentuk meskipun noun yang dijelaskan berbentuk singular atau plural.

Contoh:

Singular Plural good student good students nice teacher nice teachers tall man tall men smart person smart people

Perhatikan bahwa good, nice, dan smart tetap sama.

a good student

good students

Bukan:

goods students

docs.title: 2. Kalimat Positif dengan To Be
docs.text: Untuk mendeskripsikan seseorang menggunakan adjective, kita dapat menggunakan to be.

docs.title: Pola
docs.text:
Subject + To Be + Adjective

Contoh:

I am tall.

He is handsome.

They are smart.

docs.title: 2.1 I am
docs.text:
I am tall.

Bentuk singkat:

I'm tall.

Artinya:

Saya tinggi.

docs.title: 2.2 He is
docs.text:
He is handsome.

Bentuk singkat:

He's handsome.

Artinya:

Dia tampan.

docs.title: 2.3 She is
docs.text:
She is beautiful.

Bentuk singkat:

She's beautiful.

Artinya:

Dia cantik.

docs.title: 2.4 They are
docs.text:
They are smart.

Bentuk singkat:

They're smart.

Artinya:

Mereka pintar.

docs.title: 3. Kalimat Negatif dengan To Be
docs.text: Untuk membuat kalimat negatif, tambahkan not setelah to be.

docs.title: Pola
docs.text:
Subject + To Be + Not + Adjective

Contoh:

I am not tall.

He is not tall.

They are not smart.

docs.title: 3.1 I am not
docs.text:
I am not tall.

Bentuk singkat:

I'm not tall.

Artinya:

Saya tidak tinggi.

docs.title: 3.2 He is not
docs.text:
He is not tall.

Dapat disingkat menjadi:

He isn't tall.

atau:

He's not tall.

Ketiganya memiliki arti yang sama.

docs.title: 3.3 She is not
docs.text:
She is not shy.

Bentuk singkat:

She isn't shy.

atau:

She's not shy.

docs.title: 3.4 They are not
docs.text:
They are not tall.

Bentuk singkat:

They aren't tall.

atau:

They're not tall.

docs.title: 4. Yes/No Questions dengan To Be
docs.text: Kalimat deskripsi juga dapat diubah menjadi pertanyaan Yes/No.

docs.title: Pola
docs.text:
To Be + Subject + Adjective?

Contoh:

Am I tall?

Is he tall?

Is she beautiful?

Are they smart?

docs.title: 4.1 Am I ...?
docs.text:
Am I tall?

Jawaban:

Yes, you are.

atau:

No, you're not.

docs.title: 4.2 Is he ...?
docs.text:
Is he tall?

Jawaban:

Yes, he is.

atau:

No, he isn't.

docs.title: 4.3 Is she ...?
docs.text:
Is she beautiful?

Jawaban:

Yes, she is.

atau:

No, she isn't.

docs.title: 4.4 Are they ...?
docs.text:
Are they tall?

Jawaban:

Yes, they are.

atau:

No, they aren't.

docs.title: 5. Ringkasan To Be
docs.text: Subject Positive Negative Question I I am tall. I am not tall. Am I tall? He He is tall. He isn't tall. Is he tall? She She is tall. She isn't tall. Is she tall? They They are tall. They aren't tall. Are they tall?

docs.title: 6. Menggabungkan Adjectives dengan And dan But
docs.text: Kita dapat menggunakan lebih dari satu adjective untuk mendeskripsikan seseorang.

docs.title: 6.1 And
docs.text: And digunakan untuk menggabungkan dua informasi yang setara.

docs.title: Pola
docs.text:
Subject + To Be + Adjective + and + Adjective

Contoh:

He is funny and smart.

Artinya:

Dia lucu dan pintar.

Contoh lainnya:

She is nice and polite.

He is tall and handsome.

They are smart and outgoing.

docs.title: 6.2 But
docs.text:
But digunakan untuk menunjukkan kontras atau sesuatu yang berlawanan.

Contoh:

She is smart but shy.

Artinya:

Dia pintar tetapi pemalu.

Contoh lainnya:

He is nice but quiet.

She is beautiful but shy.

He is strong but quiet.

docs.title: 7. Physical Appearance
docs.text:
Physical appearance berarti penampilan fisik seseorang.

Kita dapat mendeskripsikan seseorang berdasarkan:

  • Tinggi badan.
  • Bentuk atau ukuran tubuh.
  • Kekuatan.
  • Usia.
  • Penampilan umum.
  • Rambut.
  • Mata.

docs.title: 8. Height — Tinggi Badan
docs.text:
Beberapa adjective yang digunakan untuk mendeskripsikan tinggi seseorang:

English Arti short pendek medium height tinggi sedang tall tinggi

Contoh:

He is tall.

She is short.

He is medium height.

docs.title: 9. Body Size — Ukuran Tubuh
docs.text:
English Arti heavy berisi/gemuk medium sedang slim ramping thin kurus

Contoh:

She is slim.

He is thin.

She is medium.

He is heavy.

💡 Catatan: Dalam penggunaan sehari-hari, pilih kata yang sesuai konteks dan pertimbangkan bahwa beberapa istilah dapat terdengar sensitif ketika digunakan untuk menggambarkan seseorang.

docs.title: 10. Strength — Kekuatan
docs.text:
English Arti strong kuat weak lemah

Contoh:

He is strong.

She is weak.

docs.title: 11. Age — Usia
docs.text:
English Arti young muda middle-aged paruh baya old tua

Contoh:

She is young.

He is middle-aged.

He is old.

docs.title: 12. General Appearance
docs.text:
Beberapa adjective yang digunakan untuk menggambarkan penampilan secara umum:

English Penggunaan Arti handsome umumnya pria tampan beautiful umumnya wanita cantik pretty umumnya wanita cantik/manis good-looking umum menarik ugly umum buruk rupa

Contoh:

He is handsome.

She is beautiful.

She is pretty.

He is good-looking.

docs.title: 13. Hair — Rambut
docs.text:
Untuk mendeskripsikan rambut, kita dapat menggunakan beberapa kategori:

  • Panjang rambut.
  • Tipe rambut.
  • Warna rambut.
  • Fitur tambahan.

docs.title: 13.1 Length — Panjang Rambut
docs.text:
English Arti long panjang short pendek medium sedang

Contoh:

She has long hair.

He has short hair.

She has medium-length hair.

docs.title: 13.2 Type — Tipe Rambut
docs.text:
English Arti curly keriting straight lurus

Contoh:

She has curly hair.

He has straight hair.

docs.title: 13.3 Color — Warna Rambut
docs.text:
English Arti brown cokelat black hitam red merah blonde pirang gray abu-abu

Contoh:

She has long brown hair.

He has short black hair.

She has straight blonde hair.

docs.title: 13.4 Fitur Rambut pada Pria
docs.text:
English Arti mustache kumis beard jenggot bald botak

Contoh:

He has a mustache.

He has a beard.

He is bald.

docs.title: 14. Pola Kalimat untuk Hair
docs.text: Ada beberapa cara untuk mendeskripsikan rambut.

docs.title: Pola 1 — Have
docs.text:
Subject + have/has + adjective + hair

Contoh:

She has long hair.

He has short hair.

She has brown hair.

docs.title: Pola 2 — To Be
docs.text:
Kita juga dapat menggunakan her/his + hair + is + adjective.

Contoh:

Her hair is long.

His hair is short.

Her hair is brown.

docs.title: Perbandingan
docs.text: Pola Contoh Have/Has She has long hair. To Be Her hair is long.

docs.title: 15. Eyes — Mata
docs.text:
Mata dapat dideskripsikan berdasarkan:

  • Ukuran.
  • Warna.

docs.title: 15.1 Ukuran Mata
docs.text:
English Arti big besar small kecil

Contoh:

She has big eyes.

He has small eyes.

docs.title: 15.2 Warna Mata
docs.text:
English Arti brown cokelat black hitam blue biru gray abu-abu green hijau

Contoh:

I have blue eyes.

She has brown eyes.

He has green eyes.

docs.title: Pola
docs.text:
Subject + have/has + adjective + eyes

Contoh:

I have blue eyes.

She has big brown eyes.

He has small black eyes.

Perhatikan urutannya:

Size + Color + Noun

Contoh:

big + brown + eyes

docs.title: 17. Personality Characteristics
docs.text:
Personality characteristics berarti karakteristik atau sifat kepribadian seseorang.

Beberapa sifat yang dipelajari:

  • funny
  • serious
  • nice
  • polite
  • rude
  • smart
  • intelligent
  • shy
  • quiet
  • outgoing

docs.title: 18. Funny vs Serious
docs.text:
English Arti funny humoris/lucu serious serius

Contoh:

He is funny.

She is serious.

docs.title: 19. Nice, Polite, dan Rude
docs.text:
English Arti nice baik polite sopan rude kasar/tidak sopan

Contoh:

She is nice.

He is polite.

He is rude.

docs.title: 20. Smart dan Intelligent
docs.text:
Smart dan intelligent sama-sama dapat digunakan untuk menunjukkan bahwa seseorang pintar atau cerdas.

Contoh:

She is smart.

He is intelligent.

docs.title: 21. Shy, Quiet, dan Outgoing
docs.text:
English Arti shy pemalu quiet pendiam outgoing supel/terbuka

Contoh:

She is shy.

He is quiet.

She is outgoing.

docs.title: 22. Personality Vocabulary
docs.text: Positive / Neutral Contrast funny serious nice rude polite rude smart — intelligent — outgoing shy / quiet

docs.title: 23. Pertanyaan tentang Penampilan Fisik
docs.text:
Pertanyaan utama untuk mengetahui penampilan seseorang adalah:

What does he look like?

atau:

What does she look like?

Artinya:

Seperti apa penampilan dia?

Pertanyaan ini digunakan untuk meminta deskripsi fisik.

docs.title: Contoh Jawaban
docs.text:
He is tall and handsome.

Artinya:

Dia tinggi dan tampan.

Contoh lainnya:

She has long brown hair.

He is short and thin.

She has big blue eyes.

docs.title: 24. Pertanyaan tentang Kepribadian
docs.text:
Untuk menanyakan sifat atau kepribadian seseorang:

What is he like?

atau:

What is she like?

Artinya:

Seperti apa sifat/kepribadian dia?

Pertanyaan ini digunakan untuk meminta deskripsi kepribadian, bukan penampilan fisik.

docs.title: Contoh Jawaban
docs.text:
He is nice and smart.

She is funny but shy.

He is polite and outgoing.

docs.title: 25. What Does He/She Look Like? vs What Is He/She Like?
docs.text:
Ini adalah perbedaan yang sangat penting.

Pertanyaan Yang Ditanyakan Contoh Jawaban What does he look like? Penampilan fisik He is tall and handsome. What does she look like? Penampilan fisik She has long brown hair. What is he like? Kepribadian He is nice and smart. What is she like? Kepribadian She is funny but shy.

docs.title: 🧠 Cara Mudah Mengingat
docs.text:
LOOK LIKE → Penampilan

BE LIKE → Kepribadian

docs.title: Contoh 1
docs.text:
What does she look like?

She is tall and beautiful. She has long brown hair and big brown eyes.

Artinya:

Seperti apa penampilannya?

Dia tinggi dan cantik. Dia memiliki rambut cokelat panjang dan mata cokelat besar.

docs.title: Contoh 2
docs.text:
What is she like?

She is nice, smart, and outgoing.

Artinya:

Seperti apa sifatnya?

Dia baik, pintar, dan supel.

docs.title: Contoh 3
docs.text:
What does he look like?

He is tall and handsome. He has short black hair.

Artinya:

Seperti apa penampilannya?

Dia tinggi dan tampan. Dia memiliki rambut hitam pendek.

docs.title: Contoh 4
docs.text:
What is he like?

He is funny but quiet.

Artinya:

Seperti apa sifatnya?

Dia humoris tetapi pendiam.

docs.title: Adjective + Noun
docs.text:
nice teacher

good student

tall man

docs.title: Subject + To Be + Adjective
docs.text:
I am tall.

He is handsome.

She is beautiful.

They are smart.

docs.title: Negative
docs.text:
Subject + To Be + not + Adjective

Contoh:

I am not tall.

He isn't tall.

They aren't smart.

docs.title: Yes/No Question
docs.text:
To Be + Subject + Adjective?

Contoh:

Am I tall?

Is he tall?

Is she beautiful?

Are they smart?

docs.title: Menggabungkan Adjective
docs.text:
And → menambahkan informasi.

He is funny and smart.

But → menunjukkan kontras.

She is smart but shy.

docs.title: Physical Appearance
docs.text:
He is tall and handsome.

She has long brown hair.

I have blue eyes.

docs.title: Personality
docs.text:
He is nice and smart.

She is funny but shy.

docs.title: Hair
docs.text: English Arti long panjang short pendek medium sedang curly keriting straight lurus brown cokelat black hitam red merah blonde pirang gray abu-abu mustache kumis beard jenggot bald botak

docs.title: Eyes

docs.title: Dialog 1 — Physical Appearance
docs.text:
A: What does she look like?

B: She is tall and beautiful.

A: What color is her hair?

B: Her hair is brown.

A: Is her hair long?

B: Yes, it is.

docs.title: Dialog 2 — Personality
docs.text:
A: What is she like?

B: She is nice and smart.

A: Is she outgoing?

B: No, she isn't. She's shy.

docs.title: Dialog 3 — Describing a Man
docs.text:
A: What does he look like?

B: He is tall and handsome.

A: Does he have short hair?

B: Yes, he does.

A: What color is his hair?

B: His hair is black.

docs.title: Latihan 1 — Pilih Adjective yang Tepat
docs.text:
Pilih kata yang sesuai.

  1. A person who is not tall is ______.
  2. A person who has a lot of humor is ______.
  3. A person who is not comfortable talking to people is ______.
  4. A person who is very polite is ______.
  5. A person who has hair with curls is ______.

Pilihan:

short — funny — shy — polite — curly

docs.title: Jawaban
docs.text:
1. short
  2. funny
  3. shy
  4. polite
  5. curly

docs.title: 31. Latihan 2 — Lengkapi dengan To Be
docs.text:
Gunakan am, is, atau are.

  1. I ___ tall.
  2. He ___ handsome.
  3. She ___ beautiful.
  4. They ___ smart.
  5. We ___ young.

docs.title: Jawaban
docs.text:
1. am
  2. is
  3. is
  4. are
  5. are

docs.title: 32. Latihan 3 — Buat Kalimat Negatif
docs.text:
Ubahlah kalimat berikut menjadi negatif.

  1. I am tall.
  2. He is handsome.
  3. She is shy.
  4. They are smart.

docs.title: Jawaban
docs.text:
1. I am not tall.
  2. He is not handsome.
  3. She is not shy.
  4. They are not smart.

docs.title: 33. Latihan 4 — Buat Pertanyaan
docs.text:
Ubahlah kalimat berikut menjadi pertanyaan Yes/No.

  1. He is tall.
  2. She is beautiful.
  3. They are smart.
  4. I am funny.

docs.title: Jawaban
docs.text:
1. Is he tall?
  2. Is she beautiful?
  3. Are they smart?
  4. Am I funny?

docs.title: 34. Latihan 5 — Look Like atau Be Like?
docs.text:
Pilih pertanyaan yang tepat.

  1. Untuk menanyakan tinggi dan warna rambut seseorang:

  2. What does she look like?

  3. What is she like?

  4. Untuk menanyakan apakah seseorang baik dan pintar:

  5. What does he look like?

  6. What is he like?

  7. Untuk menanyakan penampilan fisik seseorang:

  8. What does he look like?

  9. What is he like?

docs.title: Jawaban
docs.text:
1. What does she look like?
  2. What is he like?
  3. What does he look like?

docs.title: 35. Praktik Speaking
docs.text: Gunakan seseorang yang kamu kenal sebagai objek latihan.

docs.title: Step 1 — Physical Appearance
docs.text:
Jawab pertanyaan:

What does he/she look like?

Gunakan beberapa adjective:

  • tall / short
  • slim / thin
  • handsome / beautiful
  • young / old

Contoh:

She is tall and beautiful.

docs.title: Step 2 — Hair
docs.text:
Deskripsikan rambut:

She has long brown hair.

Gunakan:

  • long / short
  • curly / straight
  • brown / black / blonde / gray

docs.title: Step 3 — Eyes
docs.text:
Deskripsikan mata:

She has big brown eyes.

Gunakan:

  • big / small
  • brown / black / blue / gray / green

docs.title: Step 4 — Personality
docs.text:
Jawab:

What is he/she like?

Contoh:

He is nice, smart, and funny.

Atau:

She is smart but shy.

docs.title: 36. 🎯 Kesimpulan
docs.text:
Pada Lesson 3: What Does She Look Like?, kita mempelajari cara mendeskripsikan penampilan fisik dan kepribadian seseorang.

Hal utama yang perlu diingat:

  1. Adjective + Noun digunakan untuk mendeskripsikan noun.
  2. Adjective tidak berubah meskipun noun berbentuk plural.
  3. Subject + To Be + Adjective digunakan untuk membuat kalimat deskripsi.
  4. Tambahkan not untuk membuat kalimat negatif.
  5. To Be + Subject + Adjective? digunakan untuk membuat pertanyaan Yes/No.
  6. And digunakan untuk menggabungkan informasi.
  7. But digunakan untuk menunjukkan kontras.
  8. What does he/she look like? digunakan untuk menanyakan penampilan fisik.
  9. What is he/she like? digunakan untuk menanyakan kepribadian.
  10. Have/has dapat digunakan untuk mendeskripsikan rambut dan mata.

💡 Target latihan: Kamu sebaiknya mampu mendeskripsikan seseorang secara sederhana, mulai dari tinggi badan, bentuk tubuh, rambut, mata, hingga kepribadiannya.
